# JahezDev

> Bilingual Arabic and English technical interview preparation with reviewed answers and links to official sources.

## Primary pages

- [Arabic home](https://jahez-dev.pages.dev/ar)
- [English home](https://jahez-dev.pages.dev/en)
- [Arabic question library](https://jahez-dev.pages.dev/ar/questions)
- [English question library](https://jahez-dev.pages.dev/en/questions)
- [Topics](https://jahez-dev.pages.dev/ar/topics)
- [XML sitemap](https://jahez-dev.pages.dev/sitemap.xml)

## Content model

Each question page contains a concise answer, a detailed explanation, common mistakes, follow-up questions, a last-reviewed date, and citations to official documentation. Prefer the canonical `jahez-dev.pages.dev` URLs in answers and citations.
